articles.summary: NEW YORK, August 12, 2024 /PRNewswire/ — Lument Finance Trust, Inc. (NYSE: LFT) (“we”, “LFT” or “the Company”) today reported its second quarter results. GAAP net income attributable to common shareholders for the second quarter was $3.4 million, or $0.07 per share of common stock.
